item.tib: zhi ba spyi 'dul g.yung drung yongs rdzogs kyi phyag bzhes bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu
item.coloph: zhi ba spyi 'dul g.yung drung yongs rdzogs phyag bzhes bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba dad 'jug grogs kyis rkyen bskul ngor dang / rang nyid na so'i brjed dwogs ched du dge bsod mtshams pa'i (pas) dar sdings nye 'dabs shig tu sbyar ba dge'o//
